lane: Content + mobile + backend/AI: Bản đồ số “Báo cáo tổng hợp”, lots R0-R2 of docs/proposals/ASTRO_NUMEROLOGY_SYNTHESIS_TWO_SYSTEMS_PLAN_2026-11-28.vi.md (Owner decisions 28/11/2026)
goal: R0: draft UI strings for the synthesis report (7 sections, table of contents, consent box, errors, coming soon, saved-report row, regenerate rules) in a new store packages/content/data/numerology-report.json with its own draft review block (the Owner-approved numerology-blocks.json is not edited, so the approved screens and the deployed ai-numerology-message content gate keep working), and a draft prompt numerology_report_system (vi+en). R1: app payload buildReportPayload (computed numbers and block ids only) with privacy tests, the report screen with table of contents, part 1 built locally for Free, parts 2-7 dimmed for Free, Premium consent box and call, saved on device under nilaza.numerology.report.v1 keyed by a hash of the number set, reuse when unchanged, regenerate only when the personal year or the birth date/name changed, a card under the private-message card, a saved-report row in Tôi là ai, inclusion in Export data. R2 (code only): Edge Function ai-numerology-report with the plan section 4 gate order, shared report payload validation, route numerology_report, quota numerologyReport 1/day + 2 failures, output check inside the router, migration file (switch OFF, route row, allowlists; no new table), Admin catalog and contract entries, Data safety and privacy drafts. Nothing is applied, deployed or switched on.
successCriteria: Report payload holds no name, normalized name, birth day/month/year, age, age range or letter totals; tests prove it.

Function order: auth 401 -> strict switch 503 feature_paused -> approved content (numerology-blocks.json and numerology-report.json, named reviewer) 503 content_not_approved -> Premium 403 -> quota 429 -> bounded body; unknown keys 400; tests show the body is not read before the quota.

Model output is checked inside the router: 7 fixed section ids (name section only when name numbers were sent), blockIds subset of the sent ids and of the right section, <=350 words per section, banned words, no 'sẽ'/'will', no 4-digit number; failure is 503 report_unavailable, not counted as delivered, no canned text.
ai-numerology-message handler, index and its tests are unchanged and stay green.
Migration only widens allowlists and inserts the switch (enabled=false) and route rows; static SQL test asserts this.

App: Free sees TOC and part 1 without any network call; Premium consent box says only numbers and block codes are sent; saved report reused while the number set is unchanged; Tôi là ai shows View/Delete; Export data includes the report.
untouchedSurfaces: No SQL applied, no Edge Function deployed, no secret set or read, no switch enabled, no Play Console change: each is a separate Owner approval by hash.
ai-numerology-message (handler, index, tests) and _shared/numerology-blocks.ts / numerology-message-prompt.ts are not edited, so the running function needs no redeploy.
packages/content/data/numerology-blocks.json stays approved and unchanged; the new strings live in numerology-report.json (draft).
PLAN.md, TwoSystems*, twoSystemsModel*, PaywallPanel.tsx belong to other work and are not touched.
Prompt is not Admin-editable; feature not added to model campaigns.
